headline: Saints Row: The Third Remastered Now Available on Android & iOS
summary: Experience the full open-world action on your mobile device with customizable controls and gamepad support. A premium release with a one-time purchase.
details: Feral Interactive has officially launched Saints Row: The Third Remastered for Android and iOS devices. This premium title offers the complete open-world experience with all the missions, driving, and combat players expect.

The mobile port features customizable touchscreen controls, catering to players who prefer on-screen buttons. For those seeking a more traditional gaming experience, full gamepad support is also included.
Unlike many mobile games, Saints Row: The Third Remastered is a premium release, meaning it requires a one-time purchase rather than a free-to-play model with in-app purchases.
To run the game, Android users will need Android 13 or later and approximately 19.3GB of free storage space. The gameplay footage was recorded on a device with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

headline_marked: [[Trifecta Checker]] stops lethal AI agents with one API call
headline: Trifecta Checker stops lethal AI agents with one API call
summary: A new tool, built for the Meta Global AI Hackathon Japan 2026, aims to prevent AI agents from becoming data-theft tools by checking for a specific set of capabilities.
details: A developer has created a tool called Trifecta Checker, designed to identify and block potentially harmful AI agents. This innovation was developed for the Meta Global AI Hackathon Japan 2026.

The concept of a 'lethal AI agent' was coined by Simon Willison, referring to an AI agent that possesses all three key capabilities that could enable it to be used for malicious purposes, such as data theft.

Trifecta Checker functions by utilizing a single API call to assess whether an AI agent exhibits these three critical traits. If the agent meets the criteria, the tool can prevent its further operation.
The project is open-source, with a live demo available for users to test and an API ready for integration into other systems. The GitHub repository provides full access to the code for developers.
This development addresses growing concerns about the potential misuse of advanced AI capabilities and offers a proactive solution for securing AI systems against malicious exploitation.
